name: A unit created mid-month is billed for chargeable days only
title: SC-13-03-15 A unit created mid-month is billed for chargeable days only
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a new owned vacant unit with monthly tariff 1500.00 is created on "2026-11-16"
When the manager accrues November
Then the unit's owner is charged 750.00 principal for 15 days
And the ledger invariants hold
